description: Monthly US electricity generation by source from EIA. Sources: solar, wind, hydro, nuclear, geothermal, biomass, all. Optional state filter (default national). Returns generation in megawatt-hours.

end.description: Inclusive upper-bound period (ISO date or YYYY-MM).

start.description: Inclusive lower-bound period (ISO date or YYYY-MM depending on series cadence).

state.description: Two-letter state code or 'US' for national rollup. Default 'US'.

name: eia_renewable_generation
